payload.text: Issue 0649, on vc's order of 2026-11-10: MEASURE FIRST, then report the size to vc before building. One booked run counting each lint IN-RS-CODE-001 and -002 name (needless_pass_by_value, redundant_clone; unwrap_used, expect_used, panic over intentd and testkit) per crate, then a proposal: which lints are enabled where, and which leave critic_tool_codes.
